section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study sample of 322 female university students enrolled at a university in Greater London (age M = 24.72, SD = 5.90; BMI M = 21.67, SD = 3.48). The ethnic composition is reported (63.7% European Caucasian, 13.7% Asian, 13.7% African Caribbean, 9.0% other) and religious affiliation breakdown is provided. No information is given about survey method, body appreciation assessment, or BMI measurement method.
section_summary.evidence_source: The participants of this study were 322 female university students enrolled in a number of courses at a university in Greater London (age M = 24.72, SD = 5.90; BMI M = 21.67, SD = 3.48). The majority of participants were of European Caucasian descent (63.7%), while the remainder were of Asian descent (13.7%), African Caribbean descent (13.7%), or other ancestry (9.0%). Most participants self-reported as being atheists (40.1%), while others were Christians (23.9%), unsure of their religious beliefs (12.4%), Muslims (8.7%), or of some other religious background (14.9%).
